title: Reactjs and React Native web-developer
jobDescription:
Official GITA IT role on the verified first-party page: Reactjs and React Native web-developer. Job summary: Build pixel-perfect, UI across both web and mobile platforms. Design, develop, secure high performing applications using Reactjs, React Native for both web & mobile. Translate designs & wireframes into a high-quality code & UI. Leverage native APIs for deep integrations with both platforms. Diagnose, fix bugs & performance bottlenecks that feels native. Reach out to the open source community to encourage & help implement mission-critical software fixes
- React Native moves fast & often breaks things. Maintain code & write automated tests to ensure the product is of the highest quality Skills

RESPONSIBILITIES:
2-4 years software development experience. Hands on experience in Reactjs, React Native, Redux. Firm grasp of the Java Script language & its nuances, including ES6 syntax. Object-oriented programming. Write well-documented, clean Java Script code. Working with third-party dependencies and debugging dependency conflicts. Familiarity with native build tools, like XCode, Android Studio. Understanding of REST APIs, the document request model, & offline storage. Experience with automated testing suites, like Jest. Key skills: Reactjs, React Native, ES6, xcode, restapi, android studio, Jest.

title: Tech Lead
jobDescription:
Official GITA IT role on the verified first-party page: Tech Lead. Job summary: We are looking for MEAN with react experiance candidate. Minimum 5 years of experiance in software development industry. Need to manage a team and strategize to deliver the product on time.

RESPONSIBILITIES:
Working experience of RESTful APIs. Well acquainted with working in an Agile environment. Well versed with the relevant coding standards. Develop high performance & scalable applications. Hands-on experience in Reactjs, Angular 6+. Working experience in Node.Js, Mongo DB and Express. Hands on experience with Java Script Development on both the client and server-side. Experience in working with different front-end components. Experience in working with RESTful APIs and Routers. Key skills: Express.js, Node.js, Full Stack Development, Angular JS, React Native, Software Development, React.js.
